meta.title: Northwind site clone: information architecture
meta.source: Local clone of the watershed.com/en-GB design (Northwind placeholder content), React + Vite
meta.generatedBy: ia-builder, with route partition computed from project code

categories.SHELL: Site chrome that wraps a page: promo bar, navigation and footer, in the variants a route can opt into.
categories.HERO: The page-opening block above the first content band.
categories.PROOF: Social proof and credibility: logos, testimonials, customer stats, analyst awards.
categories.FEATURES: Product explanation modules: capability rows, step tabs, carousels, demos.
categories.CONTENT: Substantive body bands: prose, tables, grids, statements, FAQs, bespoke one-page bodies.
categories.CONVERSION: Calls to action and forms: demo requests, gated downloads, newsletter and email capture.
categories.FEED: Collections of linked content: card grids, lists, filters, featured sliders, related-link sets.
categories.ARTICLE: Reading layouts for long-form pages: posts, customer stories, legal documents, with their navigation aids.

shell.promo-bar.description: Thin dark bar above the nav that rotates through offer messages with prev/next arrows; below 700px the active message scrolls as a marquee.
shell.promo-bar.scope: Used on 555 routes (home, product, company, customers-index, customer-story, blog-index, blog-post, guides-index, guide, events-index, event, legal, compare, tool, report-landing).

shell.nav.description: Sticky 68px top navigation: wordmark, three hover dropdown menus (Product, Resources, Company), a Customers link, Sign in and Book a demo; a hamburger panel with drill-in submenus below 1024px. Variants: opaque, translucent (turns opaque on first scroll), inverted (white text over a dark hero, no demo button).
shell.nav.scope: Used on 561 routes (home, product, company, customers-index, customer-story, blog-index, blog-post, guides-index, guide, events-index, event, legal, compare, demo, product-tour, tool, report-landing).

shell.footer.description: Peach-to-cobalt gradient call-to-action strip with a collapsible demo form, above a dark link panel (seven link groups, locale select, legal row) with a large outlined arc decoration on the right.
shell.footer.scope: Used on 558 routes (home, product, company, customers-index, customer-story, blog-index, blog-post, guides-index, guide, events-index, event, legal, compare, product-tour, tool, report-landing).

shell.footer-short.description: The same footer with a shorter call-to-action strip: heading plus a single email-capture field and centred legal copy instead of the demo form.

hero.home.description: Homepage hero: dithered landscape backdrop, decoding-text eyebrow ticker, H1, email field joined to a button on a glass pill, colour-tile block around a product image with a typing prompt pill, 6x2 customer-logo grid with hover case-study strips, and a three-column testimonial row.

hero.default.description: Standard product-page hero: eyebrow, H1, subhead and primary/secondary buttons beside a 552px media square on a pale-blue gradient (variants for 3:4 media and background tint).

hero.video.description: Large-type hero with a 64px H1 and a wide autoplay-video placeholder panel below it, on a pale gradient.

hero.centered-agent.description: Centred AI hero over a purple glow field: pill, H1, subhead, CTAs, then the shared typing prompt demo with suggestion chips.

hero.large-background.description: Tall centred hero with a logo mark, 64px H1, subhead and a small button over a large decorative illustration.

hero.compete.description: Comparison-page hero: intro copy plus a panel of comparison tiles or links and a proof strip with chevron controls.

hero.carousel.description: Marketplace hero with a sliding carousel of partner/integration cards.

hero.energy-forecast.description: Energy-management hero: intro text, a ringed prompt pill and a dark glass frame holding a forecast chart image.

hero.form.description: Hero with the conversion form built in (dark theme for demo pages, light for tours and tools): copy, feature list, stats or quote on one side and a form card or banner form on the other.

hero.lp.description: Campaign-page hero: uppercase eyebrow, light-weight 60px H1, body copy and a single arrow button, with a cursor-following highlight.

hero.feed-carousel.description: Autoplaying featured-story carousel that opens blog, guides and events indexes: media beside title and excerpt, progress dots and a pause control.

hero.customers.description: Customers index hero: eyebrow, serif H1 and lead copy beside a tall video placeholder with a play button.

hero.change.description: Full-bleed photo hero for the Change page with a logo row, a three-line uppercase wordmark and a small caption.

hero.climate-leads.description: Blue hero with a right-aligned serif H1, intro paragraphs, a row of round avatar chips and a photo closed by an angled white cut.

hero.soc-banner.description: Full-width banner image that starts under the nav at the top of the report landing pages.

proof.logos.description: Static customer-logo strip under a hero: mono label above a row of invented logo marks (small and medium sizes).
proof.logos.scope: Used on 20 routes (product, compare, demo, company).

proof.logo-marquee.description: Stepped customer-logo carousel that moves one logo slot at a time while on screen; logos are grey and turn colour on hover (dark tone available).

proof.awards-slider.description: Analyst-recognition section: eyebrow, H2, paragraph and call to action beside an award badge and a looping badge slider. The call to action is two buttons on the homepage and a single mono link on product pages.

proof.quote.description: Single testimonial: logo tile in a bordered cell beside a large quote, name and role, with optional prev/next arrows for several quotes.
proof.quote.scope: Used on 25 routes (product, demo, product-tour, company).

proof.quote-background.description: Large pull quote set over a dark full-bleed image, without attribution.

proof.quote-features.description: Testimonial paired with a short list of feature highlights.

proof.quotes-carousel.description: Horizontally sliding row of quote cards (408px pitch) with detail lines.

proof.quote-video.description: Bordered callout pairing a customer quote with a video thumbnail and centred play button (medium and small sizes).

proof.customer-photo-feature.description: Row of portrait photo cards each carrying a headline customer metric, with a header link and slider arrows.

proof.people-carousel.description: Slider of people cards (marketplace partners and experts).

proof.personnel-slider.description: Full-bleed slider of 240px staff cards (photo, name, role) with a header and round arrow controls.

proof.stats-cornerstone.description: Homepage stats card: four headline statistics in a row, a dotted divider band, then an illustration beside supporting text.

proof.stats-ruled.description: Row of large statistics separated by thin rules (comparison page).

proof.text-with-logos.description: Text column with a link beside a dithered grid of logo tiles that swap on a timer.

proof.customer-logo-grid.description: Customers index band of 12 logo tiles that flip to new logos every few seconds.

proof.quote-carousel.description: Customers index slider of large customer quotes with avatar, advancing automatically with dot controls.

features.product-overview.description: Product tour band: three auto-advancing steps (6-second progress bar, expanding description) beside a stage image and screen panel; dark on the homepage, light mode available.

features.feature-carousel.description: Header with arrow controls above a track of 384px feature cards that moves one card per click and supports drag.

features.ai-agents-demo.description: Homepage AI section over a purple glow: three feature columns, then a glass prompt card that types example prompts, with suggestion chips.

features.text-with-image.description: The workhorse feature row: eyebrow, title, body and a bullet list or link beside a media box; image side alternates.

features.text-with-image-list.description: Alternating rows on a 12-column grid, each an image beside a text column.

features.text-with-image-ordered-list.description: Up to four numbered steps, each a 512px media beside copy, alternating sides (industry pages).

features.feature-large.description: Large intro (eyebrow, H2, body in two columns) above a grid of icon-tile feature items.

features.animated-gallery.description: Marketplace gallery of tiles that stack and slide in as the page scrolls.

features.animated-steps.description: Campaign-page step list with a progress bar that auto-advances and pauses on hover (static list below 900px).

content.feature-text.description: Big centred statement: 48px H2, optionally with a call-to-action button or section-heading treatment.

content.section-text-block.description: 752px prose column using the shared article text styles, optionally with a table of contents and margin annotations.

content.grid.description: Two- or three-column item grid with a header; items can be numbered, image-topped or plain.

content.content-grid.description: Bento grid of wide, half and narrow media cards with title, description and link.

content.text-with-list.description: Icon and 60px intro title beside columns of list items on a 12-column grid.

content.tables.description: Titled comparison table with alternating banded rows.

content.table-questions-stats.description: Comparison table of questions with supporting statistics.

content.faq.description: Accordion of questions that slide open, with a call-to-action box; a compact variant sits inside gated landing cards.
content.faq.scope: Used on 32 routes (product, compare, company, report-landing).

content.faq-full-width.description: Full-width FAQ list with its own heading and spacing.

content.header-band.description: Eyebrow, title and body header band, used to open a page or to introduce a mid-page section.

content.horizontal-rule.description: Thin 1152px rule that separates bands on long-form pages.

content.video.description: Bordered 16:9 video placeholder with a play overlay (no embed).

content.info-cards.description: Heading and cards over a full-bleed photo background.

content.link-list.description: Header with a list or chips of links.

content.mission-split.description: Homepage split band: dark text panel with a dashed cobalt rule beside a full-height photo with a gold dot-grid overlay.

content.gated-card.description: Left column of a gated landing page: mono kind label, large title and body copy in a ruled white card over a blueprint grid.
content.gated-card.scope: Used on 187 routes (guide, event, company, report-landing).

content.event-logistics.description: Blue date, time and location block inside an event landing card.

content.event-speakers.description: Speakers list on event landing pages: square photo beside name and role.

content.summit-intro.description: Summit event opener: large mono title, date lines, intro copy and a waitlist form card.

content.summit-speakers.description: Summit speaker grid inside a white card.

content.summit-sessions.description: Summit agenda: time pill, title and description per session.

content.careers-intro.description: Dark photo header across both columns with H1 and intro paragraphs.

content.careers-roles.description: Roles header, department filter pills and department-grouped job rows with locations and chevrons.

content.careers-sidebar.description: Right column of link sections separated by dotted rules, ending in a photo slider.

content.brand-logos.description: Light and dark logo tiles with spec rows and download chips, plus a trademark note.

content.brand-colour.description: Nine colour swatches with names, hex values and copy buttons.

content.brand-typography.description: Sans, serif and mono type samples with captions.

content.brand-press-kit.description: Press-kit heading and a primary download button.

content.change-statement.description: Tall scroll runway with a sticky large statement followed by highlighted paragraphs and a primary button.

content.change-stats.description: Second scroll runway: a pinned photo panel with two bordered statistic boxes and white paragraphs.

content.climate-leads-interviews.description: Alternating interview sections: round avatar, serif name, Q&A and a ruled aside with logo, facts and an optional diagram; pull quotes between.

content.soc-text-card.description: Bordered white card with cobalt H1 and report description with a custom bullet list.

conversion.inline-cta.description: Call-to-action band in recessed, inline or stacked variants: text plus one primary button.

conversion.inline-cta-form.description: Newsletter-style email capture band built on the shared email-catcher form.

conversion.cta-form.description: Closing form band for the marketplace page.

conversion.content-form.description: Bordered two-panel block: option rows on the left, request form on the right.

conversion.cta-bar.description: Slim call-to-action row: title and one button between rules.

conversion.gated-form.description: Right column of a gated landing page: cover image, cobalt heading and the shared form with floating labels.
conversion.gated-form.scope: Used on 187 routes (guide, event, company, report-landing).

conversion.newsletter-band.description: Bracketed newsletter sign-up band; inset after the sixth card in feed grids and shown above related content on posts.

conversion.quiz.description: Quiz card on a gradient band: intro, six question slides with progress bar and previous/next, then a form slide.

conversion.soc-form-card.description: Cover image above a bordered form card, with a decorative footer image band.

conversion.summit-closing-cta.description: Bordered translucent closing band: summit name, date line and a Register button that scrolls to the form.

feed.content-cards.description: Header with a button above three 16:9 image cards with eyebrow, title and a read-more or description line.

feed.page-link-set.description: Related-pages block: title and three linked media cards.

feed.page-links.description: Related-resources cards that fade up as they scroll into view (the one scroll reveal on the site) and slide on small screens.
feed.page-links.scope: Used on 189 routes (customer-story, guide, event, company, report-landing).

feed.blog-posts-theme-images.description: Grid of bordered post cards with figure, title and arrow.

feed.filter-bar.description: Filter chips (and, on the blog, a search box) that write a filter query parameter.

feed.card-grid.description: Three-column grid of content cards; on filterable feeds a newsletter band is inset after the sixth card.

feed.load-more.description: Load more button that reveals twelve further cards.

feed.related-posts-grid.description: Grid of related content cards at the foot of a post.

feed.sidebar-index.description: Index page with a full-height sidebar (title, anchor nav, contact notice) beside ruled list rows: coverage and release rows on news, document links on legal.

feed.featured-stories.description: Customers index slider of featured story cards with a hover overlay.

feed.all-customers.description: Filterable customers grid: three selects (region, industry, type) that rewrite the URL query; cells show a logo and reveal title and footer on hover.

article.post-hero.description: Post opener: breadcrumbs, date, title, subtitle and a 552px media image, under a translucent nav.

article.prose.description: Article body in the shared prose styles: 20/30 text, headings, nested lists, quotes, figures with caption pills, callouts, tables and inline code; followed by a topics row on most posts.

article.toc.description: Sticky table of contents beside the article that highlights the section in view (starts with an Introduction item).

article.story-hero.description: Customer story header: logo, title and subtitle over a wide banner with a play control.

article.story-sidebar.description: Sticky full-height sidebar with customer facts, product list, section links and a next-story button.

article.story-body.description: Story sections beside the sidebar: media, quote and prose sections that the sidebar links track.

article.legal-document.description: Legal document page: back link strip, serif light-weight H1 and legal prose.

article.manifesto.description: Long essay on a 752px column: 64px H1, body, H2s and bordered chart figures with captions.
